// PROBE for tests/unit/score-containment.test.ts — never compiled (PW-BRIDGE-01 A-12).
// A review card that renders the score recorded at review-open, and a timeline badge
// that renders the score's movement. Both are the portfolio score by another name.
export function Probe({ review, entry }: any) {
    return (
        <dl>
            <dd data-fact="review.scoreAtOpen">{review.scoreAtOpen}%</dd>
            <span data-fact="timeline.scoreDelta">{entry.scoreDelta > 0 ? "+" : ""}{entry.scoreDelta}</span>
        </dl>
    )
}
